final: WITH customer_order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_orders FROM customer_order_counts) SELECT c.customer_id, c.order_count, CAST(c.order_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_orders as ratio FROM customer_order_counts c CROSS JOIN total_sum t WHERE t.total_orders IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
